description: This file defines a static helper class ManageNavPages to manage navigation state in Razor views for the Manage pages in an ASP.NET Core MVC application. It contains properties for page names and methods to determine the active page's CSS class, facilitating dynamic navigation highlighting.

classes.name: ManageNavPages
classes.description: A static class providing helper methods and properties to manage active page highlighting in the navigation for the Manage section.

methods.name: IndexNavClass
methods.description: Returns 'active' if the current page is Index, otherwise an empty string.

methods.name: ChangePasswordNavClass
methods.description: Returns 'active' if the current page is ChangePassword, otherwise an empty string.

methods.name: ExternalLoginsNavClass
methods.description: Returns 'active' if the current page is ExternalLogins, otherwise an empty string.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthenticationNavClass
methods.description: Returns 'active' if the current page is TwoFactorAuthentication, otherwise an empty string.

methods.name: PageNavClass
methods.description: Determines CSS class for navigation item based on whether it matches the active page.

methods.name: AddActivePage
methods.description: Extension method to set the active page in ViewData.
